Bug_Title: BOA: Class overrides a method implemented in super class Adapter wrongly (BOA_BADLY_OVERRIDDEN_ADAPTER)
Bug_Details:
This method overrides a method found in a parent class, where that class is an Adapter that implements
a listener defined in the java.awt.event or javax.swing.event package. As a result, this method will not
get called when the event occurs.
Bug_Explanation: The class 'BadlyOverriddenAdapter' incorrectly overrides the 'actionPerformed' method from the 'MyActionListener' class, which implements 'ActionListener'. The overridden method is not used in the event listener setup, hence it will not be called when the event occurs.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls example.showBug(), which initializes the UI and sets up a button with an action listener. However, the setup uses MyActionListener instead of BadlyOverriddenAdapter, so the overridden method in BadlyOverriddenAdapter is never called, leading to the issue. The test case fails because it asserts false unconditionally to simulate the expectation failure due to the bug.
